## 3. Data Import and Cleaning

```{r load-libraries}
# Load all required packages
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
library(e1071)
library(pheatmap)
library(pROC)
library(corrplot)
library(randomForest)
```

#{r import-data}
# Load the dataset
df <- read.csv("C:/Users/ADMIN/Documents/Bioinformatic-Project---2020-ASP-83/Data/heart.csv")

# Check size
dim(df)

# Check for missing values
sum(is.na(df))

# Convert categorical variables to factors
df$sex <- factor(df$sex, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("Female", "Male"))
df$cp <- factor(df$cp, levels = c(0,1,2,3), labels = c("Typical Angina", "Atypical Angina", "Non-anginal", "Asymptomatic"))
df$fbs <- factor(df$fbs, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
df$restecg <- factor(df$restecg, levels = c(0,1,2), labels = c("Normal", "Abnormal", "Hypertrophy"))
df$exang <- factor(df$exang, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
df$target <- factor(df$target, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No Disease", "Heart Disease"))

# Check cleaned data
str(df)


## 4. Exploratory Data Analysis

#{r eda-plot1}
# Figure 1 - Age distribution by heart disease outcome
plot1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = age, fill = target)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 1: Age Distribution by Heart Disease Status",
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Number of Patients",
    fill = "Diagnosis"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(plot1)
ggsave("Output/figure1_age_distribution.png", plot1, width = 8, height = 5)


#{r eda-plot2}
# Figure 2 - Chest pain type by heart disease outcome
plot2 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = cp, fill = target)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 2: Chest Pain Type by Heart Disease Status",
    x = "Chest Pain Type",
    y = "Number of Patients",
    fill = "Diagnosis"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1))

print(plot2)
ggsave("Output/figure2_chest_pain.png", plot2, width = 8, height = 5)


#{r eda-plot3}
# Figure 3 - Boxplots of cholesterol and max heart rate by outcome
plot3 <- df %>%
  select(target, chol, thalach) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(chol, thalach), 
               names_to = "Variable", 
               values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(Variable = recode(Variable,
    "chol" = "Cholesterol (mg/dl)",
    "thalach" = "Max Heart Rate (bpm)")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = target, y = Value, fill = target)) +
  geom_boxplot(color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~Variable, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 3: Cholesterol and Max Heart Rate by Heart Disease Status",
    x = "Diagnosis",
    y = "Value",
    fill = "Diagnosis"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(plot3)
ggsave("Output/figure3_boxplots.png", plot3, width = 8, height = 5)


#{r eda-heatmap}
# Figure 4 - Correlation heatmap of clinical features
library(pheatmap)

# Select numeric columns and calculate correlation
numeric_df <- df %>%
  select(age, trestbps, chol, thalach, oldpeak, ca) %>%
  cor()

# Save heatmap
png("Output/figure4_heatmap.png", width = 800, height = 600)
pheatmap(numeric_df,
         main = "Figure 4: Correlation Heatmap of Clinical Features",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50),
         display_numbers = TRUE,
         number_format = "%.2f",
         fontsize = 12)
dev.off()

# Display heatmap
pheatmap(numeric_df,
         main = "Figure 4: Correlation Heatmap of Clinical Features",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50),
         display_numbers = TRUE,
         number_format = "%.2f",
         fontsize = 12)
